app.run: The app is the simulator panel MakeCode embeds beside its simulator (a Vite page, no backend, no login). Start it with `node .obeya/app.mjs start` (after `npm ci`): it starts in the background, in this workspace, the Vite dev server on port 3400 (the port MakeCode's devUrl names; a free one when another workspace holds it) and a fake dashboard server on 3401 (or a free one), waits until both answer, and prints both URLs; they are also in `node_modules/.obeya-app.json` (panelUrl, harnessUrl). Open the harnessUrl for anything worth showing: it embeds the panel at its MakeCode size, announces the dashboard `demo-klasse` the way a program with the IoT blocks does, and lists beside it the `IOT1:` lines the panel sends down to the simulator and the feed names it hands to the editor. The fake dashboard has five readings (temperatur, nachricht, ziel from the dashboard; licht and temperatur from the mini 48213); temperatur and licht change every few seconds, so the panel visibly follows them. `?scope=d` (dashboard only), `?scope=g` (minis only) or `?scope=a` (default, both) on the harness URL picks whose values the program reads. The panel's look comes from a Campus page (`/embed/iot-sim`) in a nested iframe: `?campus=<origin>` on the harness URL names the Campus that draws it (start a Campus workspace with its own `node .obeya/app.mjs start` and take the origin from its `.obeya/run/app.json`, e.g. `https://localhost:5301`); without it, or with nothing answering there, the panel shows its own bare list after three seconds. The panelUrl alone shows only the empty state („Kein Dashboard“). Vite reloads the panel by itself after a change under `src/`, and the harness announces the dashboard again to the reloaded panel; nothing to do. After a change to `.obeya/app.mjs`, start again (it stops the old run first). A real MakeCode or campus needs a running editor with `simxdev=1` and a real dashboard token; neither is needed or available for a demo. Stop it with `node .obeya/app.mjs stop`, which kills exactly the processes it started here, by PID.
